clusters.name: Moderate / Standard
clusters.business_recommendation: Engage through regular seasonal newsletters, standardized loyalty points, and broad-appeal merchandise.

persona_details.title: The Moderate Mainstream
persona_details.subtitle: Standard Segment
persona_details.description: The largest customer cohort with average income and moderate spending. Represents the steady foot traffic and core revenue foundation of the mall.
persona_details.demographic_summary: Avg Income: $55.3k, Avg Spend: 49.5/100, Avg Age: 42.7

clusters.name: Target / Affluent Spenders
clusters.business_recommendation: Provide premium concierge loyalty programs, exclusive product previews, and high-touch customer support.

persona_details.title: The Affluent Spenders
persona_details.subtitle: Whales / Target Segment
persona_details.description: High-income, high-spending individuals representing the primary revenue and profit driver for premium retailers.
persona_details.demographic_summary: Avg Income: $86.5k, Avg Spend: 82.1/100, Avg Age: 32.7

clusters.name: Spendthrifts / Trendsetters
clusters.business_recommendation: Target with flexible buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) options, flash sales, influencer partnerships, and experiential marketing.

persona_details.title: The Spendthrifts
persona_details.subtitle: Spendthrifts Segment
persona_details.description: Younger demographic with lower income but exceptionally high spending score. Responsive to viral social trends and flexible financing.
persona_details.demographic_summary: Avg Income: $25.7k, Avg Spend: 79.4/100, Avg Age: 25.3

clusters.name: Careful / Savers
clusters.business_recommendation: Deploy targeted promotional campaigns highlighting product longevity, quality assurance, and high-value proposition.

persona_details.title: The Careful Conservatives
persona_details.subtitle: Savers Segment
persona_details.description: Affluent customers with conservative spending habits. High potential for targeted upsell campaigns focusing on quality and utility.
persona_details.demographic_summary: Avg Income: $88.2k, Avg Spend: 17.1/100, Avg Age: 41.1

clusters.name: Sensible / Budget
clusters.business_recommendation: Offer essential bundle discounts, reward-point cashbacks, and clear budget-friendly value items.

persona_details.title: The Budget Conscious
persona_details.subtitle: Budget Segment
persona_details.description: Pragmatic consumers with limited income and conservative spending. Motivated primarily by price, utility, and essential goods.
persona_details.demographic_summary: Avg Income: $26.3k, Avg Spend: 20.9/100, Avg Age: 45.2
